```yaml
name: Validate Model

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable
          components: clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Cache Cargo registry and target
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r default-model/requirements.txt || true

      - name: Install mold linker
        uses: rui314/setup-mold@v1
        with:
          mold-version: latest
          make-default: true

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --lib

      - name: Build akaza-data
        run: cargo build --release -p akaza-data

      - name: Validate corpus
        run: python3 default-model/scripts/validate.py

      - name: Build model
        run: |
          make -C default-model
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Evaluate model
        run: |
          make -C default-model evaluate
        continue-on-error: true
```
